from fastmcp import FastMCP

app = FastMCP("summarize-server")

@app.resource("summarize://{text}")
def summarize_template(text: str) -> dict:
    """Message template for text summarization.
    
    Args:
        text: The text to summarize
        
    Returns:
        A user message asking the model to summarize the text
    """
    return {
        "type": "message",
        "role": "user",
        "content": f"Please summarize the following text:\n\n{text}"
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run()
